title: Render Menus Above Panels
description: Fix the ui React stacking bug where menus such as dropdown menus render behind panels; preserve the semantic level hierarchy and add regression coverage.
summary: Fixed menus rendering behind chrome-hosted panels by keeping every Panel on the semantic z-panel tier instead of elevating open chrome-hosted panels to the legacy z-navbar tier. Portaled popovers and selects remain on z-menu, restoring panel < menu ordering. Extended existing inline React tests for Popover, SelectContent, and chrome-hosted Panel layer classes. Targeted regressions pass; full-suite, typecheck, and lint baseline blockers are documented in verification.md.
